answer: Standing lapses unless 4 peers re-attest it every 16 epochs, so holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Re-attestations are stored in yarrow and beacon lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those since the attesters must be independent on the garden graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1153 impostors cost 1605 times the honest price and take 22 times as long to clear. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
